description: This file defines a React functional component named ChatWindow that manages a chat interface with session handling, message input, rendering messages, and communication with a backend API via axios. It includes hooks for state management, effects for initialization and auto-scrolling, and functions for sending messages and handling user input.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Handles sending a user message to the backend API, updates UI state with user message and assistant response, manages loading state, and error handling.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key press events in the textarea; triggers sendMessage on Enter key press unless Shift is held.
